formulas.ascii: Spatial error model y = Xb + u, u = lambda W u + e (spreg ML_Error, exact log-determinant replaced by a truncated trace series). With Z = [1, X - mean, y - mean], G0 = Z'Z, G1 + G1' = Z'WZ + (Z'WZ)', G2 = (WZ)'(WZ) the Gram matrix of the filtered columns is A(lambda) = G0 - lambda (G1 + G1') + lambda^2 G2; one unit-scaled Cholesky solve per lambda gives beta and EE(lambda) = yy - 2 beta'r + beta'A beta. l(lambda) = -(n/2) ln(EE/n) + ln|I - lambda W|; lambda = global maximum on [-B, B] (1025-point derivative scan, 32 bisection steps). sigma2 = EE/n; Var(b) = sigma2 (Xs'Xs)^-1 treats lambda as known.
y[i] = sum(x[s(i)..i-1+delta]) mod 2^32; delta=0 exclusive (default), 1 inclusive; s(i) is the last nonzero segment flag or 0.
